headline: Lyft settles driver misclassification lawsuit for $272.5 million
summary: Lyft agreed to pay $272.5 million to settle a lawsuit over classifying its drivers as contractors rather than employees, resolving a case dating back to a 2020 California lawsuit. Critics quoted in coverage say affected workers are still owed far more than the settlement provides.
